data.name: Anvesh
data.gender_notes: Anvesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anvesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' meaning 'towards' and 'vidh' meaning 'knowledge'. It signifies a person who is always eager to gain knowledge and is intellectually curious. The name Anvesh carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anvesh usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is always seeking wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Anvesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anvesh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anvesh holds cultural significance as it represents the importance of education and knowledge in Hindu culture. The pursuit of knowledge is considered a noble endeavor and is encouraged from a young age. The name Anvesh may also signify an individual's thirst for knowledge and their dedication to learning and growing.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Anvesh can be seen as a reflection of the Hindu belief in the pursuit of self-knowledge and enlightenment. The name represents the inner drive to seek wisdom and understanding, not just of the world around us, but also of ourselves and our place in the universe. It may also be seen as a reminder to always be open to new ideas and experiences, and to approach life with curiosity and a desire to learn.
